summary: IM Cannabis Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 655,000 common shares at a negotiated US$2.00 per share to certain accredited investors, per a September 23, 2026 securities purchase agreement, with delivery expected on or about September 24, 2026. Gross proceeds are approximately US$1.3 million, no placement agent or underwriter is involved, and no fees or discounts are paid. Prior close was US$4.14 on September 22, 2026, implying a steep discount, after a 1-for-30 consolidation effective August 27, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and post-deal overhang.
